events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) briefly engages and attempts to quickly disengage with Vucevic (CHI) during the pick. Vucevic grasps Dinwiddie's arm to maintain the mutual and marginal contact.
Vucevic (CHI) legally contests Washington's (DAL) driving shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) trails White (CHI) and avoids making any illegal body contact as he contests White's driving shot attempt.
Huerter (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Marshall (DAL) prior to any incidental follow-through contact occurring in the post.
The loose ball inadvertently bounces off Vucevic's (CHI) leg and the leg-to-ball contact is not intentional.
The ball touches Vucevic (CHI) last before going out of bounds. Possession is correctly retained by the Mavericks.
Vucevic (CHI) moves alongside Davis' (DAL) path and maintains his left arm in a vertical position as incidental contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Terry (CHI) maintains a resting forearm on Dinwiddie's (DAL) side and the contact is marginal during the driving shot attempt.
Davis (DAL) is not wide as he establishes a screening position in Terry's (CHI) path and the contact is marginal as they come together during the pick.
Terry (CHI) legally contests Dinwiddie's (DAL) shot attempt in the lane.
Dinwiddie's (DAL) shot attempt touches the shot clock apparatus out of bounds before bouncing back into play. Therefore, an out-of-bounds violation is correctly called.
Davis (DAL) commits a take foul on Vucevic (CHI).
Terry (CHI) commits a take foul on Thompson (DAL).
Terry (CHI) wraps his left arm around Thompson's (DAL) body during his steal attempt, affecting Thompson's SQBR.
Thompson (DAL) and Giddey (CHI) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
